routing.rule: Resolve enabled account by explicit account_id, capture immutable config and credential reference, strip proxy prefix and append raw path/query to base_url. No global default selection and no model/type/version whitelist.

origins.boundary: disjoint route sets; browser Origin guard; no management CORS

request.query: preserve raw query and duplicate keys
request.body: stream bytes; no JSON parse/reserialize; preserve model, unknown fields, tool/image/audio/file payloads, multipart boundaries and encodings
request.headers: preserve application headers including content-type/content-encoding/accept, anthropic-version, beta and future fields; remove hop-by-hop + Connection-nominated headers, incoming upstream auth and local admin token; set Host and server-owned credential; regenerate transport framing; strip local Cookie header to avoid leaking browser-local credentials
request.models: no enumeration, length checks on model, version gate, type/capability allowlist, fallback insertion or override
request.websocket: Raw HTTP Upgrade handshake and opaque frame streaming with flow control; preserve compression negotiation, response headers, fragments, subprotocol and close frames. Pinned aiohttp upgrade parser hook covered by integration tests.

response.status: preserve upstream HTTP status, including errors
response.headers: preserve end-to-end headers; remove hop-by-hop and reconstruct framing
response.body: stream raw bytes with backpressure; propagate cancellation; never buffer until semantic completion
response.observability: Bounded nonblocking in-memory metadata queue, drop-on-full; no body/query/credential; no analytics implemented.

policy.test: Optional Ops action; does not gate account enabling
policy.redirects: no automatic cross-origin follow; preserve upstream 3xx
policy.limits: operational resource/time limits must be configurable, documented and independent of model names/types; no arbitrary 1 MiB probe/body restriction in forwarding path
policy.secret: Server AES-256-GCM CredentialStore implemented, SQLite transaction with CAS. Managed Key or explicit server environment reference; no plaintext keys in public DTO or browser persistence.
policy.disabled_account: Reject new requests before contacting upstream; retain original snapshot for in-flight requests.
policy.deleted_account: Reject new requests with account not found; preserve history.
policy.check_invalidation: Keep probe for name-only edits; connection/credential changes invalidate probe.

evidence: TraceMason-Service/tests/test_service.py and scripts/browser-check.mjs; real vendor credentials not exercised

provider.responsibility: Generic HTTP/SSE/WebSocket transport, profile presets, auth injection, opaque body forwarding
provider.catalog: /api/provider-profiles; provider/profiles.py source of presets and optional check samples

api_key_accounts.responsibility: Create/read/update/delete accounts; provider_kind; base_url; environment-backed API KEY reference; enable/disable
api_key_accounts.key_storage: AES-256-GCM encrypted SQLite credential rows; independent server master key; API returns presence/revision only.
api_key_accounts.update_semantics: No api_key or blank value on managed update retains current key; nonempty value atomically replaces; new managed or env→managed requires value. Never echo old key. Deleted credentials must not affect other accounts. Credentials tied to stable account ID, not shared default env names.
api_key_accounts.execution: AccountService owns business and credential policy; AccountRepository owns SQL/transactions. One dedicated worker serializes DB calls; no SQL on the network event loop.

ops.responsibility: Local management service reachability, account enable state, credential availability, latest explicit check outcome/time/latency/error
ops.status_rule: configured != enabled != upstream healthy; never tested is unknown; check failure does not auto-disable account
ops.refresh: last successful snapshot timestamp; error marks stale; opt-in 30s refresh pauses on hidden tab, open modal or in-flight operation
ops.check_interaction: Per-account AbortController cancellation; modal may close while check continues; other accounts remain usable; path/status/classification/redacted request ID shown.
ops.check_result_scope: HTTP status and stream completion only; no model-semantic success claim

migration.preserve: account IDs, URL validation, env credential refs, atomic write, guards, original transport evidence
migration.changes: provider_kind explicit; enabled explicit; remove global active and probe-age gate; model is optional probe hint only; separate modules
migration.old_default: drop active pointer only after explicit design approval; preserve all account configurations

credential_store_design.storage: SQLite transaction stores encrypted credential record and account config reference together; replacing JSON-only storage is explicit v0.1.1 design adjustment
credential_store_design.cipher: AES-256-GCM via maintained crypto library, random nonce per write; AAD includes stable account ID and key version
credential_store_design.master_key: server deployment secret outside database and source tree; no key in browser; must be available before accepting managed-key writes
credential_store_design.read: account query returns presence and configured state only; Gateway resolves secret internally
credential_store_design.atomicity: check expected configuration generation inside transaction; credential replacement and metadata update commit together; rollback retains previous config and secret
credential_store_design.audit: record actor/account/operation/time/outcome only; redact secret request fields, never log raw save bodies
credential_store_design.backup: encrypted DB and deployment master key must be backed up separately; restoration test required
credential_store_design.prototype: discard entered key after successful mock save, persist presence/revision only; input cleared on close; no encryption claim

product_boundary.credential: upstream API Key (managed or server environment)
product_boundary.codex: API credential only; no ChatGPT subscription conversion

frontend.form: auto ID / four basic fields / advanced settings
frontend.connection: copy full relay URL and generic HTTP sample
frontend.listing: disabled filter / sort / client pagination / responsive action menu
frontend.navigation: Left main navigation for service modules; header shows current page only; mobile uses drawer, never top-level horizontal menu
